import 'package:analytics/analytics.dart';
import 'package:context/context.dart';

void main() {
  final analytics = Analytics();
  final context = Context().withAnalytics(analytics);
  context.analytics.track('page_view');
  if (!identical(AnalyticsContext(context).analytics, analytics)) {
    throw StateError('Named extension invocation failed');
  }
  if (!identical(context.analytics, analytics) ||
      analytics.events.single != 'page_view') {
    throw StateError('Analytics was not supplied to the context');
  }
}
